name: Leg Press Horizontal (Machine)
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and place your feet on the platform about hip-width apart.
Release the safeties and take the weight with your legs, knees tracking over your toes.
Bend your knees to bring the platform in until your thighs are close to your torso, without letting your hips roll off the seat.
Press back out until your legs are straight but not locked.
